options.content: Determine the magnitude of the magnetic flux through the loop when the crossbar is in the position shown. The crossbar is released from rest and slides with negligible friction down the U-shaped wire without losing electrical contact.

Calculate the magnitude of the current in the crossbar as it falls as a function of the crossbar's speed $v$.
